args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. None flagged. All 8 cleared (r01 to r08).
- Checks: every run passed rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections. No run used the width-free ratio.
- Summaries: the large |z| values come from a near-zero batch MAD, not from real differences. Centre REGR peaks run from 52.84 to 52.92 %/h, about 0.15 % of the value. Every peak sits at 421 µm. Growth-zone lengths are 674 to 695 µm (up to 3 % shorter). Largest flank differences are -9.54 to -9.88 %/h, at 410 to 421 µm. Every run has the same strain-rate profile shape.
- Remedies: only r06 kept a remedy (1, no roll-backs), and its checks pass. That is the normal path.
- Flagged runs in common: none.
- Note: r01, r04, r05 and r08 have identical check values and summaries, and so do r02 and r07. This doesn't make the kinematics doubtful, but it's worth confirming that each is a separate root or time window and not a duplicate entry.
